what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the DPW director present the FY24 department budget, which the minutes describe as an increase built from averages of actuals and the current budget.
The new facilities director presented a Facilities budget and projects; the committee said that budget would also be presented to the Parks commission.
The town manager reported adjustments to the preliminary budget, including a draft school budget that lowers the preliminary figure and raises the surplus.
The committee agreed to draft its town meeting warrant letter covering Esser, overlay, free cash, Chapter 70, capital, ARPA and the tax issue.
The DPW director expects a new Chapter 90 allotment and has a balance available; no votes on budgets were taken.

why_it_matters: These are early FY24 figures for road, snow and facilities spending, and the preliminary totals can still move before town meeting, where residents vote on the budget that sets the tax bill.
The warrant letter is the committee's written advice to voters, so its topics (free cash, Chapter 70 aid, capital, ARPA and the tax issue) show which levers it expects to shape that vote.
watch_next: The Finance Committee's draft town meeting warrant letter.
Any revised preliminary budget from the town manager reflecting the school draft.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: Neither record has a vote or transfer, and the one clear match is the DPW request increase of about $158 thousand. They differ on what the committee decided: our minutes have a warrant letter and a facilities presentation to the Parks commission, and the official minutes have a report on ESSER, free cash and overlay. Our school and Chapter 90 figures have no counterpart in the official minutes, and the official minutes have many figures we lack.
